summary: [standards] Both scenarios were reworded by this change (context.capability.39: purge's closed values are two kinds plus the retired pair; report.generation.07: nine tables, not ten) but have no evidence for the current text: their only evidence records are the 0.36 (impl-evidence-audit, 2026-11-04) and 0.35 (impl-gateclean, 2026-11-03) ones. The 0.39 run (3994 passed) bound the scenarios whose test names carry their id, and these two tests do not. report.generation.07's old record is bound to snapshot_writes_ten_parquet_files_and_a_manifest_under_the_given_dir, a case that no longer exists (renamed tier_retired_13_snapshot_writes_nine_parquet_files_and_a_manifest_under_the_given_dir in canon-cli/tests/report.rs; canon-report/tests/snapshot.rs still names its nine-table test snapshot_writes_ten_parquet_files_and_a_manifest_listing_exactly_them). context.capability.39's third Then is proved by every_kind_option_value_is_a_context_kind, not by the case its old evidence names (kinds_are_every_record_kind_under_its_user_facing_name). I ran all of these tests and they pass (86 + 78 targeted tests), but a review pins the latest evidence, so I cannot sign either until evidence is recorded for the current text and the cases that prove it: canon evidence add --scenario context.capability.39 and --scenario report.generation.07 with the cases above plus tier_retired_13 / snapshot_writes_ten_... for the report one and every_kind_option_value_is_a_context_kind for the context one. Blast radius: the gate lists them as stale reviews today, so the ship guard would not catch a wrong test.
